id: 35_Safety Quiz - 2025 Workplace Safety Work at Height Safety Electrical Safety Fire
title: 四个主题二十问（国内版）
source_doc: course/Laboratory Ergonomics & RSI/35_Safety Quiz - 2025 Workplace Safety Work at Height Safety Electrical Safety Fire.md
author_source: project/Laboratory Ergonomics & RSI/35_Safety Quiz - 2025 Workplace Safety Work at Height Safety Electrical Safety Fire（国内版）/src.py

points.K1: 测验形式：四个主题各五题
points.K2: 风险评估：识别并控制风险
points.K8: 坠落制动：坠落时接住人
points.K12: 电气事故多因人为失误

shots.scene: 欣欣站在四块空白展板前
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of four blank display boards and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 四个主题，二十道题，开始！

shots.scene: 四个图标：建筑、梯子、闪电、火焰
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a building, a ladder, a lightning bolt and a flame. No people.
shots.narration: 工作场所、高处、用电、消防。

shots.scene: 阿杰和小研准备参加学院安全竞赛
shots.prompt_en: The young male student and the female graduate student sit with blank quiz cards preparing for a competition.
shots.narration: 阿杰和小研一起备赛。

shots.section_title: 测验形式：四个主题各五题
shots.scene: 四沓题卡，每沓抽出五张
shots.prompt_en: Four stacks of blank question cards, five cards pulled out from each stack. No people.
shots.narration: 每个主题挑五题，讲清为什么。
overlay: 测验形式：四个主题各五题

shots.section_title: 风险评估：识别并控制风险
shots.scene: 小研拿着风险评估表，表上高中低三格
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds a blank risk form with three colored boxes for high, medium and low.
shots.narration: 第一题：风险评估为了什么？
overlay: 风险评估：识别并控制风险

shots.section_title: 风险评估：识别并控制风险
shots.scene: 流程：找危害、排风险、定措施
shots.prompt_en: A three-step flow of icons: a magnifier, a ranking bar and a shield. No people.
shots.narration: 找危害，排高低，再定控制措施。

shots.scene: 噪声、振动、辐射、压力四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a loudspeaker, vibration waves, a radiation trefoil and a stressed face. No people.
shots.narration: 第二题：哪个不是物理危害？

shots.scene: 压力图标被单独圈出
shots.prompt_en: The stressed face icon is circled and moved to a separate group. No people.
shots.narration: 压力不是物理危害，属于心理危害。

shots.scene: 阿杰爬梯子，两手一脚在梯上
shots.prompt_en: The young male student climbs a step ladder facing it, two hands and one foot on the ladder.
shots.narration: 第三题：梯子安全的金规则？

shots.scene: 三个接触点亮起
shots.prompt_en: Three contact points on the ladder glow: two hands and one foot. No people.
shots.narration: 始终三点接触：两手一脚或两脚一手。

shots.scene: 倒金字塔五层，最上层亮起
shots.prompt_en: An inverted pyramid with five layers; the top layer with a cross icon glows. No people.
shots.narration: 第四题：危害控制第一步？

shots.scene: 欣欣指着最上层
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at the top of the inverted pyramid.
shots.narration: 能消除就先消除，防护用品放最后。

shots.scene: 墙上绿色的安全出口和急救箱标志
shots.prompt_en: A wall with an emergency exit sign and a first aid sign. No people.
shots.narration: 第五题：安全信息标志用什么颜色？

shots.scene: 红、蓝、黄色卡片打叉，绿色卡片圈出
shots.prompt_en: Red, blue and yellow cards crossed out; a green card circled. No people.
shots.narration: 绿色，提示安全信息和通道。

shots.scene: 老李站在平台边缘作业
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer works on a raised platform near its edge.
shots.narration: 高处第一题：什么算高处作业？

shots.scene: 可能坠落受伤的图标圈出
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person falling from an edge and getting hurt is circled. No people.
shots.narration: 高于地面、坠落可能受伤的作业。

shots.scene: 王老师翻开国家标准
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator opens a blank standards book.
shots.narration: 具体基准高度，按国家标准。

shots.section_title: 坠落制动：坠落时接住人
shots.scene: 老李系着安全带，挂点、绳索、缓冲器示意
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer wears a harness connected by a lanyard with a shock absorber to an overhead anchor point.
shots.narration: 高处第二题：坠落制动系统干什么？
overlay: 坠落制动：坠落时接住人

shots.section_title: 坠落制动：坠落时接住人
shots.scene: 坠落的人形被绳索拉住
shots.prompt_en: A person icon falling is caught by a lanyard. No people.
shots.narration: 万一坠落，把人接住。

shots.scene: 挂点到人之间的距离用虚线标出
shots.prompt_en: A dashed line marks the distance between an anchor point and a worker's harness. No people.
shots.narration: 高处第三题：自由坠落距离？

shots.scene: 数字卡片打叉，挂点高过头顶
shots.prompt_en: Number cards are crossed out; an anchor point is shown above head height. No people.
shots.narration: 挂点要高，坠落距离按标准控制。

shots.scene: 老李站在梯子上，旁边是高度尺
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer stands on a ladder beside a height ruler.
shots.narration: 高处第四题：多高要防坠落？

shots.scene: 英尺数字卡片打叉，国家标准书亮起
shots.prompt_en: A card with foot marks is crossed out; a blank standards book glows. No people.
shots.narration: 原题用国外数值，国内按国家标准。

shots.scene: 全身式安全带挂在架子上
shots.prompt_en: A full body harness hangs neatly on a rack. No people.
shots.narration: 高处第五题：安全带主要作用？

shots.scene: 冲击力被分散到腿、腰、肩的示意
shots.prompt_en: A body outline with arrows spreading force across the thighs, waist and shoulders. No people.
shots.narration: 分散冲击力，让人悬着等救援。

shots.section_title: 电气事故多因人为失误
shots.scene: 阿杰湿手去拔插头，被小研拦住
shots.prompt_en: The young male student reaches for a plug with wet hands; the female graduate student stops him.
shots.narration: 电气第一题：电气事故主因？
overlay: 电气事故多因人为失误

shots.section_title: 电气事故多因人为失误
shots.scene: 操作不当、不懂、未培训三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a wrong-way hand, a question mark head and a missing training certificate. No people.
shots.narration: 多是人为失误：不懂、不按规程。

shots.scene: 起重机吊臂靠近架空电线
shots.prompt_en: A crane boom near overhead power lines with a warning spark icon. No people.
shots.narration: 电气第二题：离架空电线多远？

shots.scene: 吊臂和电线之间画出安全区
shots.prompt_en: A shaded safety zone between the boom and the power lines. No people.
shots.narration: 保持安全距离，按电力安全规程执行。

shots.scene: 配电箱里的漏电保护器
shots.prompt_en: A residual current device in an electrical panel with its test button visible. No people.
shots.narration: 电气第三题：原题的缩写指什么？

shots.scene: 漏电时开关跳开，人形安全
shots.prompt_en: A leakage current icon causes the device to trip; a person icon stays safe. No people.
shots.narration: 就是漏电保护器，一漏电就断电。

shots.scene: 插线板起火，水杯泼过去的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: A burning power strip; an icon of water thrown on it is crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 电气第四题：电气火为何不能用水？

shots.scene: 小研先拉下电闸，再用灭火器
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student switches off the main power, then aims a fire extinguisher.
shots.narration: 水导电易触电，先断电再灭火。

shots.scene: 黄色三角形的当心触电标志
shots.prompt_en: An electrical hazard warning sign on a cabinet door. No people.
shots.narration: 电气第五题：电气警告标志什么色？

shots.scene: 绿、蓝、红卡片打叉，黄色圈出
shots.prompt_en: Green, blue and red cards crossed out; a yellow card circled. No people.
shots.narration: 黄色三角，提醒当心。

shots.scene: 三角形三边：氧气、热量、可燃物
shots.prompt_en: A triangle whose sides show an oxygen symbol, a thermometer and a wooden block. No people.
shots.narration: 消防第一题：火三角是什么？

shots.scene: 三样齐了才着火
shots.prompt_en: A flame appears only when all three sides are connected. No people.
shots.narration: 氧气、热量、可燃物，三样缺一不燃。

shots.scene: 楼外空地上一块集合点标志，人们排队站好
shots.prompt_en: People stand in lines at an outdoor assembly point sign; the security officer counts them.
shots.narration: 消防第二题：火灾集合点是什么？

shots.scene: 保卫处值班员清点人数
shots.prompt_en: The security officer checks names on a blank list at the assembly point.
shots.narration: 疏散后集合，方便清点人数。

shots.scene: 老李检查灭火器压力表和标签
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer checks the pressure gauge and a blank inspection tag on a fire extinguisher.
shots.narration: 消防第三题：灭火器多久查一次？

shots.scene: 检查标签上打勾
shots.prompt_en: A blank inspection tag on the extinguisher receives a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 定期检查、贴标签，周期按规定。

shots.scene: 门上方的安全出口标志亮着
shots.prompt_en: An illuminated emergency exit sign above a door. No people.
shots.narration: 消防第四题：安全出口标志指什么？

shots.scene: 箭头沿走廊通向出口
shots.prompt_en: Arrows along a corridor lead to the exit door. No people.
shots.narration: 指出火灾时最安全的疏散路线。

shots.scene: 房间里火焰突然布满整个空间
shots.prompt_en: Inside a room, flames suddenly fill the whole space. No people.
shots.narration: 消防第五题：什么是轰燃？

shots.scene: 欣欣指向出口
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points firmly toward an exit.
shots.narration: 可燃物一齐起火，必须在这之前撤离。

shots.scene: 小研深夜对着电脑叹气，桌上堆满数据
shots.prompt_en: Late at night, the female graduate student sighs at a laptop with piles of papers around her.
shots.narration: 科研压力大，也是一种危害。

shots.scene: 压力大时手抖、走神的图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a shaking hand and a distracted head with swirls. No people.
shots.narration: 压力大容易走神，操作出错。

shots.scene: 小研和老周谈心
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student talks with the older man in his office, both relaxed.
shots.narration: 说出来，和导师同学沟通。

shots.scene: 心理咨询中心的门
shots.prompt_en: A door with a heart icon on a sign in a campus building. No people.
shots.narration: 需要时找学校心理咨询中心。

shots.scene: 老李按下漏电保护器的试验按钮，开关跳开
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer presses the test button on a residual current device and it trips.
shots.narration: 漏电保护器要定期按试验按钮。

shots.scene: 开关不跳的图标打叉，旁边报修单
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a device that does not trip is crossed out, beside a blank repair form. No people.
shots.narration: 按下不跳，马上报修，不能凑合用。

shots.scene: 王老师翻开国家标准
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator opens a blank standards book.
shots.narration: 安装运行按国家标准，以现行文本为准。

shots.scene: 阿杰连续几小时坐着做题，肩膀僵硬
shots.prompt_en: The young male student has been sitting for hours with stiff shoulders and a sore neck.
shots.narration: 备赛久坐，一个姿势不动最伤身。

shots.scene: 阿杰起身做肩颈伸展
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stands up and stretches his neck and shoulders.
shots.narration: 隔一阵起身，伸展肩颈手腕。

shots.scene: 阿杰远眺窗外，喝口水
shots.prompt_en: The young male student looks out the window and drinks some water.
shots.narration: 看看远处，喝口水，再继续。

shots.scene: 四个主题图标，下面各有对勾
shots.prompt_en: Four topic icons with green checks below each. No people.
shots.narration: 先识险再控制，三点接触、先断电。

shots.scene: 阿杰和小研在竞赛台上击掌
shots.prompt_en: The young male student and the female graduate student high-five at a quiz stage.
shots.narration: 数值按国家标准，道理记心里。

shots.scene: 欣欣挥手告别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye in front of the four boards.
shots.narration: 二十问答完，安全更懂一点！
